summary: Solid production-ready deliverable with proper CI/CD integration, error handling, and TDD structure. Workflow well-designed (minimal permissions, sensible triggers, clean job ordering). Python code lacks type hints (modern best practice gap). Maintainability concerns: PROJECT_FILES list manually maintained (drift risk), glob_to_regex is dense (~40 LOC, hard to modify safely), match_pattern conflates basename extraction with matching. Priority resolution is sound but underdocumented. Minor refactoring needed: add type hints, split match_pattern into focused functions, auto-discover PROJECT_FILES.
